prompt: As of the financial year ending July 31st 2023, what was the size of the endowment at the university attended by rugby player Fred McLeod?
answer: As of **31 July 2023**, the University of Edinburgh’s endowment was valued at approximately **£559.8 million**. Fred McLeod attended the University of Edinburgh.
